Package IoTFleetManagement.agent.model

Klasse Agent

java.lang.Object
IoTFleetManagement.agent.model.Agent
@Entity public class Agent extends Object
Entity class representing an IoT Agent in the IoT fleet management system.

This class is mapped to a database table to store information about IoT agents, including their identification, authentication credentials, status, and other relevant details. The agents can be manually added to the database, and their status can be retrieved or updated.

Autor:
Lara, Jasmin1707
